I been farming this land 30 years. I do what works. I don't change much from last year because last year the harvest was okay.

My 8 mu — I put about 6 mu in wheat-maize rotation, and 2 mu in cotton on the side. Cotton don't do so good with wheat after it, so I keep it separate on the same piece every year.

For wheat in autumn: I plow the ground with the tractor service, cost about 40 yuan per mu. I plant improved seed — "Jimai" kind, whatever the dealer in town has that everyone buys. I put one bag of compound fertilizer as base, that's 40 jin, 15-15-15. Then in spring at jointing I spread urea, about 40 jin per mu, and irrigate that same time. Before winter I water once, then at jointing, then once more when grain fills. Three waters from the well. Spray once for aphids, once for rust if I see yellow on leaves. Wheat gives me maybe 900 jin per mu if the weather helps — 450 kg.

For maize after wheat: No time to plow, I just plant right into the stubble with the seeder — hybrid seed, Zhengdan or whatever my neighbor Old Wang bought. One bag compound at planting, then urea at big trumpet stage, 40 jin. Water once or twice depending on rain. Spray for borer. Gets me 1100 jin per mu, 550 kg.

Cotton needs more work and more spray. I plow that ground. I use improved seed from the shop. More fertilizer because cotton is hungry — bag and a half compound plus urea twice. Water 3 times. Spray maybe 8 times for bollworm and aphids, that's the truth of cotton. Gets me 500 jin seed cotton, 250 kg per mu. The price is okay some years.

I put a little extra fertilizer rather than too little. Fertilizer costs money but a bad harvest costs more.
